submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively on a word-initial fragment such as hab, Se, st or sh only when the completed word is used to refer to a concrete physical entity, named place, or dwelling action (habitation, Seine, stegosaurus, shillelagh); the same onset completing to an abstract process, condition, event or authorization term (habilitation, Session, sterilization, scleroderma, shortfall) leaves it near its weak baseline. Its negative-pole output direction coherently promotes the spatial tokens front and behind (Jacobian kurtosis 7.7, full lens overlap), consistent with priming spatial relations after a concrete-entity mention.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Positive holdout: novel concrete-entity use of st onset (stegosaurus as physical museum object) in a genre absent from top examples.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Day one of the overland survey began with canvas tents, spare fuel drums, paper maps, and a mule named Petra who refused every bridge. We crossed red plateaus, dry riverbeds, basalt canyons, pine ridges, lava fields, and alkali flats, logging each camp with compass bearings, barometer readings, altitude estimates, rainfall gauges, wind vanes, and sketches of rock formations. Rations ran low near the copper mine, so we traded coffee for dried apricots, mended a split axle with wire, patched a canvas awning, recalibrated the altimeter, dried our boots by a juniper fire, and copied coordinates by lantern light. Guides joined us at the border market, bringing goats, woven blankets, smoked cheese, dried figs, copper pots, and news of washed-out passes ahead. We detoured through cedar groves, limestone gorges, abandoned orchards, marble quarries, olive terraces, and a village of potters who fired blue-glazed bowls in kilns smelling of eucalyptus. Rain found us on the ridge road, turning dust to mud, soaking our journals, rusting our buckles, and forcing a night under a leaking tarp while Petra brayed at thunder. At dawn the clouds broke over pale dunes, gulls cried inland from the estuary, and we finally reached the weathered shack behind the dunes where the crew had cached fuel drums, spare rope, and dry blankets.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Positive long-context holdout: concrete dwelling word with sh onset buried deep in a long travel narrative, testing retrospective firing far from the start.
